syllabusSource.title: Indian Nursing Council, Revised Regulations and Curriculum for B.Sc. (Nursing) Program, Regulations 2020 (Gazette of India, 5 July 2021), Communicative English, pages 244–247; assessment scheme on page 238 and pass rules on page 242

units.title: Communication and the roles of listeners, speakers, readers and writers
Introduction to LSRGW: sounds, stress, intonation, medical vocabulary, tenses and linkers
Speaking: effective conversation, telephone talk, handover and presentations
Reading: strategies, medical vocabulary, abbreviations, visuals, reports and remedial grammar
Writing skills: patient history, notes, letters, reports, journals, abstracts and CV
LSRW skills in combination: critical thinking, presentations, instructions and error analysis
